record.original_question: For the moduli space H_g of smooth hyperelliptic curves of genus g and the p-rank stratum V_{g,f}, is the scheme-theoretic intersection V_{g,f} intersect H_g reduced?

evidence.quote: Question 5.6 Is Vg,f intersect Hg reduced?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix a prime $p$ and work over an algebraically closed field of characteristic $p$. Let $\mathcal{A}_g$ denote the moduli space of principally polarized abelian varieties of dimension $g$, and for $0 \le f \le g$ let $V_{g,f} \subset \mathcal{A}_g$ be the $p$-rank stratum consisting of (the closure of) the locus of principally polarized abelian varieties whose $p$-rank equals $f$ (i.e. whose group scheme of $p$-torsion has étale rank $p^f$). Let $\mathcal{H}_g \subset \mathcal{M}_g$ be the moduli space of smooth hyperelliptic curves of genus $g$, embedded into $\mathcal{A}_g$ via the Torelli map sending a curve to its Jacobian. Consider the scheme-theoretic intersection $V_{g,f} \cap \mathcal{H}_g$ inside $\mathcal{A}_g$.

Question: Is the scheme $V_{g,f} \cap \mathcal{H}_g$ reduced for every $g \ge 2$ and every $0 \le f \le g$?
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work (e.g., Achter–Pries 2011, and a 2025 preprint on heuristics for (ir)reducibility of p-rank strata of hyperelliptic moduli) studies the dimension and irreducibility of these strata, but none of the located sources explicitly resolves the reducedness of the scheme-theoretic intersection $V_{g,f} \cap \mathcal{H}_g$. The status appears to remain unresolved in the literature found.

status_evidence.title: The p-rank strata of the moduli space of hyperelliptic curves (Achter–Pries)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies dimension and irreducibility properties of p-rank strata in the moduli of hyperelliptic curves, without explicitly addressing reducedness of the scheme-theoretic intersection.
status_evidence.claim: Related results on the p-rank stratification of hyperelliptic moduli are obtained, but reducedness of V_{g,f} ∩ H_g is not explicitly resolved.

status_evidence.title: Heuristics for (ir)reducibility of p-rank strata of the moduli space of hyperelliptic curves (arXiv:2506.06457)
status_evidence.snippet: Recent heuristic and computational work on irreducible components of p-rank strata of hyperelliptic moduli.
status_evidence.claim: Recent research focuses on (ir)reducibility/components rather than on reducedness of the scheme-theoretic intersection.
